BO makes an angle $\theta=45^{\circ}$ with the vertical direction, and the system remains in equilibrium. If the position of the pulley is kept unchanged and the magnitude of θ is changed, then the change in the magnitude of the force exerted on the pulley by the wooden rod is (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the pulley axle is at point O, the rope is connected horizontally from the right side of the pulley to point A on the wall on the right, and the other segment hangs the heavy object C downward from the pulley; the wooden rod BO slants upward to the left from near the pulley, a vertical dashed line is drawn beside it, and the angle between BO and the vertical direction is marked as θ. Then reason: isolate only the pulley to analyze the forces. The mass of the pulley itself can be neglected, and it is subjected to the tensions of the two segments of the rope: the horizontal segment gives the pulley a horizontal tension, and the vertical segment gives the pulley a vertical tension. Since it is the same light rope and the heavy object is stationary, the magnitudes of the tensions in the two segments are equal, set as T, and T is equal to the gravity of the heavy object. The directions of the two rope segments are determined by the horizontal segment and the vertical segment, and they are always perpendicular to each other, so the magnitude of the resultant force of the rope on the pulley is R=√(T²+T²)=√2T. When the system is in equilibrium, the magnitude of the force exerted by the wooden rod on the pulley must be equal to the magnitude of this resultant force. When the pulley position is kept unchanged and the heavy object is unchanged, the directions of the rope segments and the tension T are both unchanged, so the magnitude of the force exerted by the wooden rod on the pulley does not change with θ.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：绳子绕过定滑轮后，一段水平连到右侧墙上 A，另一段竖直向下挂重物 C；木杆 BO 斜向左上，与竖直线夹角标为 θ。再从题干读出：滑轮质量可忽略、轻绳、系统平衡、滑轮位置保持不变，只改变 θ。解题时只隔离“滑轮”作受力分析：滑轮受到两段绳子的拉力，因同一根轻绳且重物静止，两段张力大小均为 T，且 T 等于重物重力；两拉力方向始终由图示的水平段和竖直段决定，互相垂直。木杆对滑轮的作用力必须与这两个绳子拉力的合力平衡，所以其大小等于合力大小 R=√(T²+T²)=√2T。由于保持滑轮位置不变且绳段方向、重物重量不变，T 不变，故 R 不随 θ 改变；θ 变大或变小时，木杆作用力大小都不变。
